wire.host_speed.retire_below_tps.label: retire slow host (tok/s)
wire.host_speed.retire_below_tps.help: Experimental, off by default: evidence is from one model/run. A positive floor stops pinning a host after three long replies below this output-token/sec rate, excluding local consumer time. 0 clears speed exclusions on the next request; cache-miss exclusions remain. Moving hosts may start a cold prompt cache.
